key.name: icon-size
key.description: Height of an app icon in pixels.

key.name: icon-spacing
key.description: Space between neighbouring icons in pixels.

key.name: vertical-offset
key.description: Moves icons up (negative) or down (positive) from the centre of the panel, without moving the indicator.

key.name: indicator-style
key.description: Shape of the running indicator drawn beneath an icon.

key.name: indicator-thickness
key.description: Height of the indicator bar, or radius of the dot, in pixels.

key.name: indicator-bottom-margin
key.description: Gap between the indicator and the bottom edge of the panel, in pixels.

key.name: show-window-count
key.description: Show the number of open windows in a badge on top of an icon that has more than one.

key.name: group-windows
key.description: Whether an app gets one icon for all its windows, or one icon per window.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where the taskbar sits: far left of the panel, left after the workspace pill, center, or right before the status area.

key.name: show-previews
key.description: Show live window thumbnails when hovering an icon with open windows, instead of the text tooltip.

key.name: preview-size
key.description: Maximum width of one window thumbnail in pixels. Thumbnails shrink when too many to fit.

key.name: show-favorites
key.description: Show pinned apps even when they are not running.

key.name: isolate-workspaces
key.description: Only show apps with a window on the active workspace.

key.name: hidden-apps
key.description: Desktop file ids of apps the panel never shows, running or not.

key.name: hotkeys
key.description: Super+1 to Super+9 activate the icon in that position, instead of the Nth favorite in the dash.
